title: Filter scoped customer order evidence by customer and original currency
description: Users narrow the existing customer-shipment field designer by optional positive CustomerId and a supported original Currency. Add narrow request/filter validation and service query predicates; reuse established CurrencyAmountRules supported-code semantics, uppercase known codes and reject unsupported codes/invalid IDs before source reads. Omitted filters retain all current known/unknown-currency evidence and legacy API compatibility. Do not add an unknown-currency selector or new customer lookup endpoint. Keep mandatory scope and optionally add compatible filter arguments to GetCustomerShipmentStatsAsync; intersect CustomerId with scope and filter order Currency before the 501-order probe and the 10001-detail probe, never filter only after grouping or paging. Out-of-scope IDs produce no names/amounts. Catalog exposes supported filters without data leakage. Preview/detail Excel/detail PDF rerun current normalized filters and visibly preserve server filter context even when corresponding columns are hidden. Reset page when filters change; preserve fields/date/page size and inputs on invalid/denied/network/download failures. Preserve existing order-status/date/caps/exact-unit/unknown semantics. Development only: reuse the existing customer-shipment menu, fresh current-user SalespersonDataScopeService, approved nondeleted SalesOrders/SalesOrderDetails and existing OperationLogMiddleware HTTP audit. Evidence remains approved sales orders, never actual shipment/stock-out/container/collected-revenue evidence. All endpoints recheck identity/menu/data scope, fail closed on invalid inputs, revoked permissions and bounded source overflow; no client identity/scope/rows/amounts as authority or permission expansion. No arbitrary/model-generated SQL, direct business table writes, domain entities or persistence schema changes, migrations, schema/view/stored-procedure changes, production SQL or real database execution, credentials/secrets/.env/config changes, irreversible operations, production deployment or real browser acceptance. Preserve unrelated modules and uncommitted work. Run focused in-memory service/API/export/UI source-contract tests and configured safe Release build/test; any unavailable external database/browser acceptance must be explicitly environment-blocked, never fabricated passed.
acceptance_criteria: Validated optional customer/known-original-currency predicates intersect mandatory fresh scope in the source before cap probes; omitted filters preserve legacy evidence and no scope-free bypass is introduced.

Designer/catalog/preview/detail Excel/detail PDF use identical current normalized filters and server context, reset changed-filter pages and preserve safe empty/error states without unauthorized names.
Focused source/API/export/UI regressions cover invalid and revoked scope, currency codes, filtering before caps, defaults and unknown evidence; safe Release build/test passes.
